proposed_metadata.title: Accuracy, Storage, and Update Cost in Reference-Assisted Sensor Calibration: Reproducibility Data

creators.name: Kuznetsov, Oleksandr
creators.affiliation: eCampus University, Italy; V.N. Karazin Kharkiv National University, Ukraine

proposed_metadata.description: Synthetic calibration and reference-assisted recalibration records, figure inputs, source hashes, and physical Mega2560/ESP32-C3 execution logs. Sensor accuracy and drift are simulated; no physical NTC/LDR metrology or new ESP32-S3 timing is claimed. Includes original and post-review analyses with distinct seeds and identified fixtures.
